audit.why: Even at level 1, then Thresh's Q-into-E all-in dominates levels 2 through first item on low cooldowns, before Zilean's Chronoshift plus item speed flips it late.
Thresh's level-2 Death Sentence (Q, 19s at rank 1) into Flay (E) is the early spike; Zilean's answer arrives at two-plus items when Chronoshift (R) turns hook picks into non-lethal catches.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[1-6].side all say 'Skill' while content win[1-5] say 'Thresh' and win[6] says 'Zilean' — six of seven rows disagree between layers.
